Apartment for sale and Rent in Sunset at Creek Beach Building 1, Sunset at Creek Beach

Provident Real Estate is proud to present this exceptional 2-bedroom apartment located in Sunset 1, Creek Beach – Dubai Creek Harbour. Set within a premium waterfront community, this residence offers elegant living with direct beach access and tranquil lagoon views.

Property Details:

2 Bedrooms | 2 Bathrooms
BUA: 1,211 sq. ft.
Vacant & Ready to Move In
Spacious Balcony overlooking the lagoon
Large Layout – Rare to Find
Floor-to-ceiling windows with abundant natural light
Built-in wardrobes
Open kitchen
Covered parking
24/7 security & concierge services

Community Amenities:

Direct access to Creek Beach
Swimming pool & fully equipped gym
Children’s play area
Waterfront promenade

Location & Connectivity:

10 minutes to Downtown Dubai
10 minutes to Dubai International Airport
Easy access to major highways

This bright, open-plan apartment is ideal for end-users seeking a beachfront lifestyle or investors looking for a high-demand rental asset in one of Dubai’s most sought-after waterfront communities.
